steps.text: One manual step: in Steam, right-click Cyberpunk 2077 → Properties → Launch Options, add --launcher-skip. REDlauncher cannot create its OpenGL context under Wine; skipping it costs nothing.
In the same Properties window, turn the Steam Overlay OFF for this game — it black-screens the launch.
In-game: keep Ray Tracing OFF (software-translated, ~10 fps). Steam Deck preset + FSR 2.1 is the reported baseline (~17 fps avg on a base M5). First runs stutter while shaders compile; it settles.

knownIssues.fix: this recipe sets ROSETTA_ADVERTISE_AVX=1 on the bottle (same as the Advertise AVX toggle)

knownIssues.cause: launcher needs an OpenGL context Wine cannot provide
knownIssues.fix: add --launcher-skip to the game's Steam launch options
disable the Steam Overlay for this game

lastVerified.result: community reports: M4 ~17 fps avg (Steam Deck preset); M5 60-82 fps gameplay (Metal HUD), fullscreen 1920x1200, FSR 2.1 Balanced, RT local shadows ON; d3dmetal + AVX + --launcher-skip + overlay off
